requirement.en: Control an arm with six actions (down/up/left/right/grip/release) and four mutually-exclusive modes. Manual: each button moves its axis while the corresponding limit switch is off. Single-step: each Start press runs one preset action until its limit. Single-cycle: Start runs the full cycle down-grip-up-right-down-release-up-left. Continuous: Start repeats the cycle. Emergency stop stops everything.
requirement.zh: 控制一个六动作(下/上/左/右/抓/放)机械臂，四种互斥模式。手动：各按钮在对应限位未到位时驱动对应动作。单步：每次按 Start 执行一个预设动作直至到位。单周期：按 Start 执行完整周期下-抓-上-右-下-放-上-左。连续：按 Start 后循环执行。急停可随时停止所有动作。
